properties.description: Cut 2026-09-15 on Anthony's word ("cut v0.61.2"). Ships #516 — import_graph and --import refuse a document stamped by a newer reflow2 unless accept_newer, the import report names every materialised Type.property, and served_by.behind_record says when a server is older than the last reflow2 that wrote its store (the 853 root cause, closed at the operation) — and #515, serde_yaml → serde_yaml_ng 0.10 with the lockfile refreshed within declared ranges (rmcp 3.3.0 and rocksdb untouched). Patch on his word; strictly, accept_newer is a new optional parameter on import_graph, which the versioning table files as minor. The schema stamp did not move (28/65/1); no upgrade note.
properties.name: v0.61.2 — an import knows its own age, and the YAML reader is maintained again
